_comment: What the refresh workflow researches. Every activity is checked in every country ("countries": "all"), priority countries first, then the rest alphabetically. 'extra' adds single activity/country pairs.

Outdoors & travel: Flying a drone in a park
Swimming in a river or lake
On the road: Riding an e-scooter on the pavement
Using a radar detector in a car
Using a phone hands-free while driving
Alcohol, tobacco & drugs: Smoking in a bar or restaurant
Home & property: Growing vegetables in the front garden
Installing a security camera that films the street
Online & media: Recording a phone call without telling the other person
Downloading copyrighted films for personal use
